rows.en: Touya: "What the hell are those?"
Arthur: "They look like aggressive life-forms out of science fiction."
Clovis: "...I don't think we'll be making friends.
Well, let's deal with them for now.
Touya, I'm counting on you again."
Touya: "Huh?"
Arthur: "You really do seem to have some sort of natural talent.
We'll follow your orders."
Clovis: "Well, there you have it."
Touya: "Hm? Is that..."
Ai: "Moping around won't do any good,
and I'm sure Alforina wouldn't want that, either."
Touya: "Ai..."
Ai: "Besides... You wouldn't look very impressive
without your ace, would you?"
Touya: "Well, I'll let you have that one just for today."
Ai: "...Touya, thanks for earlier."
Touya: "Hey, that's the first time you've called me by my name."
Ai: "Wh-What are you talking about?! Come on, let's go!"
Touya: "Wh-What the hell?!"
Celica: "Everyone, dodge!"
Miyasco: "I'm sending the coordinates! Please get clear!"
Touya: "Th-That's incredible..."
Yamato: "Even the river's water is gone..."
Fain: "...But! It takes more than that
to finish me! Raaaaaaaah!!"
Fain: "Justice will always... triumph!"
Touya: "D-Did we get it...?"
Touya: "Huh? It can still move?!"
Yamato: "...I've got a bad feeling about this..."
Touya: "Yeah... So do I."
Yamato: "But that was amazing.
You took down something like that!"
Clovis: "Honestly... You're quite something."
Ai: "Heh heh heh. You're pretty good."
Arthur: "I'll be expecting more great things from you."
Fain: "Oh! You brought down that monster!
You're pretty good!"
Yamato: "What?!"
Touya: "Hey, come on. You've got to be kidding..."
Yamato: "Isn't this a little bad?"
Touya: "We just have to do it... Hm?"
Touya: "Wh-What the hell?!"
Celica: "Everyone, dodge!"
Miyasco: "I'm sending the coordinates! Please get clear!"
Touya: "Th-That's incredible..."
Yamato: "Even the river's water is gone..."
Yamato: "Another one's come out!"
Touya: "What the hell are these things?!"
????: "Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!"
????: "The people call! The times call! They call on me to defeat evil!
Fain Jin Barion, messenger of justice, has arrived!!"
Touya: "...It's him."
Fain: "Now that I'm here, everything will be fine!"
Fain: "Here I come, monsters! ...Hah!"
Yamato: "No way... He jumped..."
Touya: "Is he trying to kill himself?!"
Clovis: "Can Mireon pull off tricks like that, too?"
Arthur: "I'm sure he can only do it because he's Fain."
Clovis: "I see."
Touya: "He's completely reckless..."
Fain: "Heh! It looks like some of you
might put up a decent fight! Here I come!"
Assistant: "Hah, hah, hah, hah... P-Professor...
I-I can't go on..."
Murk: "You're young, yet you're already worn out.
I'm still bursting with energy!"
Assistant: "P-Professor, all you did was ride 'Little Balu'!
I had to run all the way here..."
Murk: "Don't call it a soppy name like 'Little Balu.'
It may be small, but it's a perfectly respectable Baluamy."
Assistant: "You're not getting away with changing the subject..."
Murk: "...O-Oh! Is that the Spirit Mech I've heard so much about?!"
Assistant: "Whenever things get awkward for you,
you always try to dodge the subject like that..."
Murk: "You'll never become a fine alchemist
if you fuss over every little detail.
More importantly, they defeated that thing, unfinished though it may be...
Spirit Mechs... Their performance lives up to the rumors.
And that ship, the Liebhofen... What power...
That's right! Er, you there. What was your name again?"
Assistant: "...It's Marsha Monsian.
This is the 1,240th time..."
Murk: "Oh, sorry, sorry. Let's see..."
Assistant: "It's Marsha... *sob*"
Murk: "Well, never mind those little details.
Assistant, did you record everything properly?"
Assistant: "Y-Yes! Of course, Professor!
As you can se..."
Murk: "...What's wrong?"
Assistant: "Ha, ha ha ha ha... The disk...
I didn't put it in..."
Murk: "That's two points off. Another four, and I'll use your brain
for my research."
Assistant: "Oh, Professor! You're always joking..."
Murk: "..."
Assistant: "Y-Yes... I'll be more careful from now on..."
Celica: "Hi, everyone! How've you been?"
Clovis: "Hey, were you trying to kill us?"
Celica: "You're all fine, so what's the problem?
'All's well that ends well,' right?"
Ymir: "But why are you aboard the Liebhofen?"
Clovis: "That's right. You went back to Agarthia,
didn't you?"
Fain: "Heh... A champion of justice makes a dashing entrance
when his friends are in danger."
Clovis: "...So, Celica? What's the story?"
Fain: "Hey! Don't ignore me!"
Celica: "Well, you see..."
Fain: "Aah, even the princess... *sob sob sob*"
Ymir: "Oh... Um... Fain, thank you."
Fain: "Huh?! Oh, no, i-it was nothing..."
Ymir: "But please don't do anything so reckless again."
Fain: "Y-Yes! If you ask it of me, Ymir,
then I, Fain Jin Barion, swear upon my life
to keep that promise!!"
Clovis: "...He's easy to read, isn't he?"
Arthur: "Well, there's nothing wrong with that.
He's free to choose who he's fond of."
Celica: "...Um, what were we talking about?
Oh, right. Why we're here.
Well, to put it simply, I suppose it was my brother's instructions."
Ymir: "Prince Lodis's?"
Celica: "Right. Besides, I wasn't happy with that order
to return home, either. After all..."
Fain: "P-Princess!"
Celica: "It's all right. They'll find out soon enough anyway.
We were ordered back because Agarthia's intelligence service
had obtained information about Zigrim's invasion."
Touya: "What?! You knew and ran away?!"
Yamato: "Touya!"
Celica: "Of course you'd think that.
But we'd already left Flamuelk Castle
by the time we found out, too."
Celica: "So my brother decided that at least we should get off,
and let us off along the way."
Clovis: "Then you're saying Agarthia itself
suppressed the information?"
Celica: "Unfortunately, yes. If anyone's behind something like this,
it's Marshal Revios, I'll bet."
Arthur: "Revios... Isn't he the Agarthian army's
supreme commander?"
Celica: "Yes. The marshal wants to brand Zigrim an aggressor,
proclaim that Agarthia is in the right,
and use that as a pretext for war with Zigrim.
He wants to show that Agarthia is strong,
and that it leads the continent."
Gabon: "Could you introduce us sometime soon, too...?"
Celica: "Huh? Oh, sorry.
I hadn't introduced the crew yet, had I?
We're not all here, but I'll introduce the ones who are."
Celica: "First, here's Gabon, our engineer and ship's doctor."
Touya: "Oh, you're..."
Gabon: "I'm Gabon Jin Boleisho. It's good to meet you.
How's the little one doing?"
Yamato: "We meet again!"
Gabon: "Oh, you look well.
How is it? Have you gotten used to life like that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... Sometimes my head feels
all foggy, but mostly I'm fine."
Gabon: "That's the spirit. Well, I'll be counting on you."
Celica: "And this is Baren, our helmsman and mechanic."
Baren: "...I'm Baren Jin Jokul."
Touya: "...Hey, is he in a bad mood or something?"
Celica: "He's embarrassed.
He may not look it, but he's pretty shy."
Touya: "Oh..."
Celica: "Next is Miyasco, our operator.
She's also a qualified physician."
Miyasco: "I'm Miyasco Ginia Bramble.
I hope we'll all get along."
Touya: "Oh, that voice... Right! You really saved us back there.
Without that data, we'd all have been burned
to charcoal."
Miyasco: "Oh, no... I only did what I should."
Celica: "Well, then. That should about..."
Derock: "Th-That's mean.
I'm here, too, you know."
Clovis: "...What's with the big guy?"
Celica: "Oh, don't mind him. He's a mirage."
Derock: "That's mean. After all I've done for you, Princess...
So you were just toying with me after all..."
Celica: "D-Don't say things people could get the wrong idea about!
What on earth did you interpret, and how,
to reach that conclusion?!"
Derock: "Heh... Heh heh heh."
Celica: "Aah! All right, already!
You want a proper introduction, right?!
This is Derock, our navigator and gunnery officer.
He's one of the best gunners on the continent.
...Unfortunately."
Derock: "Well, since it's you, Lady Celica,
I'll make an exception and forgive you. I'm Derock Jin Eikak.
Well, go easy on me, everyone."
Touya: "We've got a real character here..."
Ymir: "The rest of the crew will join us at the Holy Land."
Touya: "Who's left?"
Ymir: "Our observer, purser, and...
captain. Three people in all."
Touya: "The captain... Come to think of it, I haven't seen anyone who fits the bill."
Clovis: "Well, Ymir as captain might have
a nice ring to it."
Ymir: "Oh, no. I'm not really suited to that sort of..."
Celica: "All right, all right! That's enough introductions.
Let's go to Flamuelk Castle!"
Arthur: "That's..."
Celica: "Huh? What's wrong, everyone?"
Ymir: "Flamuelk Castle is already..."
Celica: "What?! What do you mean?!"
Celica: "...You're kidding, right? Queen Alforina is..."
Ai: "...Why would we lie about something like this?!
You have no idea how much I wish it were a lie!
But Alforina isn't coming back..."
Celica: "I-I'm sorry... I see..."
Fain: "What about Tyron?! Surely Tyron
was at the castle?!"
Arthur: "We don't know... But to buy us time
to escape, he..."
Fain: "Damn..."
Ymir: "In any case, there's no point in acting on our own right now.
Let's head to the Holy Land first."
Celica: "...Right. Xiujian and Aurelie are there,
and we need to think about what to do next."
Arthur: "But is it safe for us
to head straight to the Holy Land?
Even with Ymir and Lady Celica aboard,
isn't violating their airspace still a problem?"
Clovis: "Come to think of it, the Holy Land
is inside the Kingdom of Agarthia.
It's almost like they're renting the place...
They could find some excuse and, in the worst case,
even seize our Spirit Mechs."
Celica: "We don't have to worry about that. This ship has
an 'optical cloaking system.'"
Clovis: "Optical cloaking...
That's like stealth, right?"
Arthur: "No, it's even more impressive.
In addition to its excellent stealth capabilities, it should be able to
change the refractive index of the light the human eye receives..."
Touya: "What does that mean, exactly?"
Celica: "It means human eyes can't see it,
and it doesn't show up on radar, either."
Touya: "That's one hell of a handy thing to have aboard..."
Ymir: "Let's go, then.
Baren, please take us there."
Baren: "...Understood.
I'm setting course for the Holy Land."
Celica: "Ai... Are you all right?"
Ai: "...I can't keep moping forever.
Besides, Alforina will live on
in my heart... Forever..."
Celica: "Ai..."
???: "That's one victory for you, then."
Growster: "Hmph! Of course!
If our army gets serious, we can crush York in an instant!
It couldn't be easier!"
???: "You don't look very pleased about it."
Growster: "We gain nothing by invading York now.
If we're going to attack somewhere, it should be Agarthia.
Our army has the strength for it.
But that useless fool doesn't understand that!"
???: (That suited us just fine, though...)
Growster: "...Did you say something?"
Growster: "Hmph! More importantly,
how's the production line coming along?"
???: "The Hestia mass-production line will be ready soon.
Your personal machine, too, of course."
Growster: "Heh heh heh... Once it's complete...
Just you wait, Revios. I'll give you a nasty surprise...
Heh heh heh heh."
???: "Why are you so obsessed with Agarthia?"
Growster: "I can't stand that country!
And I can't stand that bastard Revios's attitude!
I just can't stand them!"
???: "I-I see... Well, fine.
Keep working toward that day, then."
Growster: "Hmph! You don't have to tell me that."
???: "...Well, I'll be on my way for today."
Bio: "Excuse m..."
Bio: "Oh, pardon me..."
Growster: "Hm? Bio, is it? How many times must I tell you?
At least knock before you come in."
Bio: "Yes, sir. I'll be more careful from now on."
Growster: "Never mind. What is it today?
I don't need any weapons."
Bio: "My, what a greeting...
General, about that man just now..."
Growster: "You don't need to know about him.
What did you come here for?"
Bio: "Yes... Well... It's about Agarthia's elector cities...
I'd like to discuss them..."
Growster: "...What about the elector cities?"
Bio: "Are you playing dumb?
You're a sly one, General... I mean the dissolution of the Agarthian Council,
and winning over the elector cities that hold the right to elect."
Growster: "What?! How do you know about..."
Bio: "That's a trade secret. But with that secret agreement,
if the elector cities stay out of the war, Agarthia's fighting strength
will fall to one-third or less... Your victory is certain."
Growster: "I know that without you spelling it all out!
What are you getting at?"
Bio: "Heh heh... That makes this simple.
Actually, I'd like you to put adoption of the Bine Daga
on hold..."
Growster: "And in return, you won't tell anyone about the secret agreement.
...Is that it?"
Bio: "Oh, no, not at all.
I only came here to discuss business."
Growster: "Hmph! I don't care if you tell anyone.
Besides, winning them over was that useless fool's
idea in the first place.
More to the point, what would that get you?
I can't see how you'd gain anything..."
Bio: "That's a trade secret, too.
But let me just say that money
isn't the only kind of profit."
Growster: "...Very well.
We have enough new models as it is,
so I'll count this as a favor you owe me."
Bio: "A favor, is it...? Very well.
Then I'm counting on your cooperation."
